age_selection.source_epoch: AD1950 documented Neotoma convention, not article date
age_selection.membership: Reuse exact maintained select() and its finite typed named-age/source-window equality guards; half-open bins from original protocol; retain missing/ambiguous/outside/allzero/refused tokens.
age_selection.bounds: No source interval distribution or probability inferred; alternate point profiles are deterministic selections.

count_model.primitive: One immutable (collection_unit_id,dataset_id,native_sample_id) observation per selected source sample; aliases/count or digest clashes refuse. Native analysis-unit IDs also retained privately, not substituted for sample identity.
count_model.axis: Exactly the common measured literal Betula/Poaceae panel, in this order, for every primitive and output; fixed N_i=n_i,Betula+n_i,Poaceae. Other NISP is excluded and separately retained, never inserted into the multinomial denominator.
count_model.covariance: C_i=diag(n_i)-outer(n_i,n_i)/N_i; plugin conditional multinomial with integer measured counts, positive panel total; count sources never independently renormalized per profile.
count_model.independence: Distinct counted native samples are conditionally independent counting observations, including samples in one core. This does not assert ecological, environmental, sediment or temporal independence. Same sample in different profiles/windows is the same primitive observation.
count_model.selection: All membership fixed conditional on the two native point chronology selections. Different chronology profiles are not independent replicate sites.
count_model.no_imputation: Missing/unmeasured axis, ambiguous literal mapping, negative/fractional/bool counts, zero total and absent source windows refuse; explicit measured taxon zero remains permitted.

ppe_model.source: Exact original source protocol/public-profile input magnitudes retained. Diagonal taxon covariance and one global two-axis shared PPE vector across all cores, windows and chronologies are declared working assumptions, not an estimated cross-core PPE covariance.
ppe_model.count_independence: Counts and PPE have zero cross-covariance conditional on this scenario; unsupported correlated/endogenous PPE is outside scope.

physical_model.binding: Read exact factors from both saved profiles at every occupied window and require parity with pair-specific source facts above; factor, radius candidate, PPE and literal axes hashed. No quadrature or new geometry or wind.
physical_model.scope: Static radius candidates remain unauthenticated historical geometry; source site/core handles and rights restrictions unchanged.

algebra.point: n_h=sum_{i in I_h} n_i; a_h=1/(k_h*p); w_h=n_h*a_h; W_h=sum(w_h); q_h=w_h/W_h. Exactly the retained original closure under matching factors and source membership.
algebra.count_J: J_hi=(identity-q_h[:,None])*a_h[None,:]/W_h for i in I_h, otherwise zero.
algebra.joint: Ccount[A,B]=sum_{i in intersection(I_A,I_B)} J_A C_i J_B.T; Cppe[A,B]=H_A Cp H_B.T; Ctotal=Ccount+Cppe. Across cores counting cross-covariance is zero; shared PPE cross-covariance remains.
algebra.contrast: D maps alternative minus reference on exactly106 matched slots, both literal axes. Propagate D C D.T including all cross-slot and cross-core blocks, not only marginal sums.19 unpaired slots keep null contrasts/SEs and exact refusals.
algebra.marginal_departure: Original pooled-window Cpool=diag(sum_i n_i)-outer(sum_i n_i,sum_i n_i)/sum_i N_i differs from sum_i C_i. Report actual old/new counting, PPE and total marginal differences at every221 occupied output. Point and PPE marginals must match; counting equality is not required. Never overwrite the original125 paired-null report.
algebra.conditioning_identity: C_pool-sum_i C_i=sum_i N_i outer(p_i-p_pool,p_i-p_pool) is PSD on the same fixed two-taxon axis; propagate via the same result count Jacobian. New counting marginal variance must not exceed old pooled counting variance beyond scale-aware tolerance. This expresses different conditioning, not improved accuracy.

public_API_proposal.boundary: Existing joint_fixed_site_covariance refuses same-unit alternate chronology overlap and uses one pooled multinomial per result. Preserve it and all its existing refusals.
public_API_proposal.identities: Primitive observation binds native collection unit,dataset,sample,source SHA256,common parameter axis,measuredmask,integercount vector. Results bind unique result ID,nonempty unique observation IDs,exactcommon parameter axis and positive deposition. No chronology-specific aliasing of primitives.
public_API_proposal.validation: All observations referenced, no duplicate native identity even with different digest, no duplicate results or member IDs, no unknown observation, no mismatched axes/unmeasured taxa, positive finite PPE/deposition/correction and covariancePSD. Explicit counting and count/PPE independence booleans; finite budgets <=512 observations,256 results,1536 cover axes. Count inputs require explicit numeric ndarrays, so mixed bool lists cannot silently become integer counts. Native(dataset,sample) cannot alias across collectionunits. Jacobian allocation capped at16,777,216 elements; finite derivatives before covariance; finite normalized symmetry checked before eigensolver.
public_API_proposal.outputs: Global cover,count/PPE Jacobians,count/PPE/total covariance,distinct observation counts,result IDs/slices and finite declared profile. No calendar labels or historical metadata fabricated by numerical API.

independent_oracle.implementation: Separate source-specific no-production-helper Decimal50 scalar algebra from exact decimal strings of retained binary64 values and integer counts. Derive q/J/H independently via quotient rule. Independent same-sample intersections and v_i=n_i0*n_i1/N_i scalar form for the two-axis covariance; explicit count/PPE/total blocks and D contrasts.
independent_oracle.scope: Compare every442 cover scalar; all three442x442 joint matrices; all three212x212 contrast matrices; Jacobians and all old/new marginal declarations. Do not call production Jacobian/covariance/normalization functions.
positives: Identical sample sets and response => zero contrast and variance
Disjoint sets => zero counting cross block, global PPE cross block retained
Single pooled observation equals existing public joint API for exactly matched configuration
Weighted between-aliquot composition PSD identity and new<=old propagated count marginals
Identical membership with different factors may have nonzero contrast/variance; zero cancellation requires identical response too
Zero measured count axes retain finite derivatives and correct zero variance without marking absent taxa measured
negative_controls: Duplicate primitive native identity/count/source aliases refuse
Malformed PPE/deposition, overflowing correction/nonPSD covariance refuse
Original pooled API alternate chronology overlap refusal preserved
Naive independent profile count blocks differ from shared-source oracle where support overlaps
Independent PPE per core/profile differs from one global PPE oracle
Pooled-window count marginal cannot be substituted for per-aliquot marginal where source compositions differ
Reused native sample under changed digest/count cannot create a new independent primitive
Source sample aliases across native collection units/datasets require actual source identity, never invented chronology IDs
Mixed boolean list counts refuse before integer coercion
Finite observation/result/Jacobian memory budgets refuse before expensive allocation
independent_oracle.tolerance_rule: Points/Jacobians use stated2e-13 absolute tolerance. Every covariance scalar additionally must satisfy abs(error)<=1e-18+5e-10*max(abs(expected),abs(actual)); if both scalars <=1e-14 require abs(error)<=5e-18. Record maximum absolute and scaled residuals, no silent floor replacement of actual matrix values.

products.public: Aggregate declared model/support counts, maxima and retained limitations; reader linked from existing primary, no new primary claim required.
products.private: Full sample memberships/count vectors/native age controls,442x442 matrices/Jacobians,125slot outputs and212x212 paired contrasts, scalar oracle comparisons and exact source/protocol hashes remain owned artifacts, no raw redistribution decision inferred.

resources.memory_enforcement: portable postrun peakRSS qualification, wall alarm enforced

acceptance_limits: This is a new first-order fixed-support counting/PPE covariance scenario, not chronology posterior propagation or calibrated interval coverage.
No independent chronology accuracy, environmental independence, biological whole-vegetation accuracy, historical LandClim reproduction, source licensing/review, or untouched validation admitted.
Original deterministic point contrasts and all missing/refused populations remain authoritative for their original scope; original pooled marginal SEs remain untouched.
Current uncertainty describes conditional local delta approximation and retains all poor/unchanged effects, exact zeros and failures.

Empirical per-aliquot taxon zero may yield degenerate plug-in count variance and understate finite-sample uncertainty. Report one-taxon-only primitives and exact-zero marginals/contrasts explicitly; variance reduction is changed conditioning, not measured precision gain.
